bridgeRouteRisk.summary: wM has one canonical Ethereum wrapper deployment; Arbitrum, Base, Plume, and Solana are bridge representations reached through M0 issuer-native burn/mint routes. Current Arbitrum and Base SpokePortal admins/operators, route paths, pause state, and upgrade implementations are structured below; Plume uses an owner-controlled Hyperlane Portal/Bridge with a separate pauser; Solana Portal message validation and Portal upgrade authority are separate from the local m_ext M-backed wrapper mint recorded in Mint Authority. The route tier remains issuer-native-lock-mint.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: wM on Ethereum is M0's WrappedM (wraps $M 1:1 via M0's own wrapper under a Migratable upgrade admin). The proxy migrated to M0's audited Wrapped M V2 implementation 0x6d9d63afccf515f393d5e65be69d38bb3b29d13 on 2026-07-31; the proxy runtime, underlying M, and M0 Minter Gateway controller 0xF7f9638cB444D65E5A40bf5fF98eBE4ff319F04e remained unchanged (verified at Ethereum block 25773353 on 2026-08-16).

routes.reviewNote: wM on Solana is the Token-2022 $wM extension mint documented in M0's Solana technical documentation. M0's Portal program mzp1q2j5Hr1QuLC3KFBCAUz5aUckT6qyuZKZ3WJnMmY validates the Wormhole message and reaches the Solana route; the local m_ext wrapper then transfers canonical M into its extension vault before minting wM. Portal bridge controls and m_ext wrapper-local authority are scored separately.

controls.label: wM Arbitrum M0 SpokePortal DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe
controls.capDescription: The Arbitrum SpokePortal is the issuer-native burn/mint route for the local wM representation. Its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safe can administer the Portal role graph and authorize replacement of the UUPS Portal logic; no independent immutable local cap was established.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Arbitrum block 495432840, hubChainId() returned 1, defaultBridgeAdapter(1) returned 0xaCffEC28C4eEe21C889a4e6C0704c540Ed9D4fDd, and that adapter was supported. At adapter block 495435471, getPeer(1) and getSenderPeer(1) both returned the adapter address and getBridgeChainId(1) returned 2; the M-to-wM and wM-to-M Portal paths both returned true.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The verified SpokePortal exposes no token-specific aggregate mint cap. The WormholeBridgeAdapter getMsgValue(1) read was 0 at block 495435471, but no token-amount rate limit was exposed; route capacity follows VAA validation and M burn/mint accounting.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Arbitrum block 495432840, the Portal implementation slot resolved to 0x9e72e098cbb48ea6b8ff317d158335a3ab048001 and the EIP-1967 admin slot was zero. At adapter block 495435471, WormholeBridgeAdapter implementation 0xa8ecb2f4265c4bf47382b229011c4b1bfb061e4b also had admin slot zero; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on both route components was held by this 3-of-5 Safe, while the separate OPERATOR_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE EOA and current Portal pause reads are recorded in the adjacent control.

controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495432840, the M0 SpokePortal's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was held by Safe 0x48670b46380fe1645f0e3e821a25162db2589d19. The Safe returned five owners, threshold 3, Safe version 1.4.1, and no enabled modules; guard and fallback-handler reads were not independently decoded. The Portal implementation was 0x9e72e098cbb48ea6b8ff317d158335a3ab048001 with no EIP-1967 admin slot, so the Safe is a bridge-route admin/upgrade controller rather than native wM Mint Authority.

controls.label: wM Plume Portal and Hyperlane Bridge owner Safe
controls.capDescription: The Plume Portal owner Safe controls the Hyperlane bridge binding, destination/path configuration, and owner-only Portal migrate(address) path. The same Safe owns the HyperlaneBridge and can change its peer; these are bridge-route controls, not independent native wM issuance.
bypassSurfaces: The owner Safe can replace Plume Portal logic through migrate(address), change the bridge binding, and change supported M/wM paths or Hyperlane peers without an independently established delay.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Plume block 87772065, Portal bridge() returned HyperlaneBridge 0x51dce104e5ba88fabc19a2c519f955bb834b0dc3; that bridge's portal() returned the Plume Portal, mailbox() returned 0x3a464f746d23ab22155710f44db16dca53e0775e, peer(1) returned the bridge address, and all M/wM path checks for hub chain 1 returned true.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The verified Plume Portal and HyperlaneBridge expose no token-specific aggregate rate-limit field; route capacity follows mailbox message validation and M burn/mint accounting. The mailbox's default ISM was not separately decoded.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Plume block 87772437, Portal owner() was Safe 0x658f3465d58518105c051C5B5f981a1038D6f5B6 and Portal paused() was true. The verified Portal source makes migrate(address), setBridge, setDestinationMToken, and setSupportedBridgingPath owner-only; the HyperlaneBridge owner() returned the same Safe and controls setPeer.

controls.evidence: At Plume block 87772437, the Portal owner was Safe 0x658f3465d58518105c051C5B5f981a1038D6f5B6. The owner Safe was observed with three owners, threshold 2, version 1.3.0, and no enabled modules; the Portal was bound to HyperlaneBridge 0x51dce104e5ba88fabc19a2c519f955bb834b0dc3, whose owner was the same Safe. The owner can alter the bridge/path configuration or migrate Portal logic; the current Portal paused state was true.

controls.capDescription: The Solana Portal validates the cross-chain Wormhole message and reaches the local m_ext route; it is bridge machinery for the wM representation, while the M-vault-before-mint wrapper invariant is separately authored in Mint Authority.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: M0 documents the Solana Portal as the Wormhole-NTT route controller that validates inbound VAAs/messages. The exact current Portal-to-m_ext invocation account set was not independently enumerated in this pass.
routeChecks.caps: The route is supply-conserving only while Portal message validation and the local m_ext M-vault-before-mint invariant hold; the local wrapper mint is not an independent native M mint.
